metadata.summary: Henry Pollock has signed a new multi-year contract extension with Northampton Saints that will see him stay at his boyhood club beyond this season.
metadata.content: Henry Pollock: England star signs new multi-year deal with Northampton Saints to stay with defending PREM champions | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Henry Pollock: England star signs new multi-year deal with Northampton Saints to stay with defending PREM champions Henry Pollock's contract with Northampton Saints had been due to expire at the end of the 2026-27 season; the England international previously said he was open to exploring all options over his future Tuesday 22 September 2026 10:03, UK Image: Henry Pollock as signed a new multi-year deal with Northampton Saints Henry Pollock has signed a new multi-year contract extension with Northampton Saints that will see him stay at his boyhood club beyond this season. Pollock has been a key part of the Saints side since bursting through as a 17-year-old in 2022, delivering a Player of the Match performance during their Gallagher PREM final victory last season. The back rower already has 13 England caps and five British & Irish Lions caps to his name, with his growing appeal seeing him become the first rugby player to join Eddie Hearn's Matchroom Talent Agency earlier this year. metadata.summary: Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar will return to action at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix after missing three races with a wrist injury.
metadata.content: Isack Hadjar: Red Bull driver to return to action at Azerbaijan GP after missing three races with wrist injury | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Isack Hadjar: Red Bull driver to return to action at Azerbaijan GP after missing three races with wrist injury Isack Hadjar missed the first three races following the summer break after sustaining a wrist injury while doing fitness training; watch every session of the Azerbaijan GP from Thursday live on Sky Sports F1, with the race on Saturday at 12pm Tuesday 22 September 2026 09:31, UK Image: Isack Hadjar will return to the Red Bull cockpit in Azerbaijan Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar will return to action at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix after missing three races with a wrist injury. Hadjar, who has fared reasonably well in his first season as Max Verstappen's team-mate, was unable to drive at races in the Netherlands, Italy and Spain after sustaining the injury while doing fitness training during Formula 1's summer break in August. The 21-year-old Frenchman's return to the cockpit will come during Thursday's two practice sessions in Baku, with this weekend's schedule moved a day earlier to avoid a clash with Azerbaijan Remembrance Day. messages.text: Why F1's intense triple header will shape title run-in

metadata.summary: Formula 1 embarks on its first triple header of the season this week with the Azerbaijan Grand Prix the first of three races in as many weekends.
metadata.content: F1 title race: Why Azerbaijan-Malaysia-Singapore triple header will shape what rest of 2026 championship chase will look like | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content F1 title race: Why Azerbaijan-Malaysia-Singapore triple header will shape what rest of 2026 championship chase will look like Kimi Antonelli's chief rivals may have all but ruled themselves out of winning the title but the season's first triple header could provide unpredictable twists; watch every session of the Azerbaijan GP from Thursday live on Sky Sports F1, with the race on Saturday at 12pm Tuesday 22 September 2026 10:29, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Craig Slater breaks down the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, including why the race takes place on a Saturday, while doing his best Craig David impression! Formula 1 embarks on its first triple header of the season this week with the Azerbaijan Grand Prix the first of three races in as many weekends. The race on the streets of Baku - which takes place on Saturday rather than the usual Sunday - was originally due to be a standalone event with the Singapore Grand Prix following on two weeks later. But the moving of the Bahrain Grand Prix to Malaysia in the week between the two events has created the run of three successive race weeks, with two more triple headers scheduled to close out the 2026 season. messages.text: McLaren predict four-way battle for Baku win after confirming more upgrades

metadata.summary: McLaren have confirmed they will bring more upgrades to this weekend's Azerbaijan Grand Prix, where they are expecting a four-way battle for victory with Mercedes, Ferrari and Red Bull.
metadata.content: Azerbaijan GP: McLaren predict four-way battle for victory with rivals in Baku after confirming more upgrades to MCL40 | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Azerbaijan GP: McLaren predict four-way battle for victory with rivals in Baku after confirming more upgrades to MCL40 McLaren have shown strong recent form with Lando Norris claiming three pole positions and two race victories across the last four rounds; watch every session of the Azerbaijan GP from Thursday live on Sky Sports F1, with the race on Saturday at 12pm Tuesday 22 September 2026 09:17, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Lando Norris says his McLaren team 'were too quick' after missing out on a crucial VSC pit stop that cost him race lead McLaren have confirmed they will bring more upgrades to this weekend's Azerbaijan Grand Prix, where they are expecting a four-way battle for victory with Mercedes, Ferrari and Red Bull. After failing to claim a victory in the first 10 grands prix of the season, the reigning constructors' champions have come into form, with Lando Norris claiming three pole positions at the last four races and only being denied a third win by the unfortunate timing of a virtual safety car last time out in Madrid. McLaren have once more exhibited strength in development, with regular upgrades brought to the MCL40 having played a significant part in catapulting them back into contention for victories. metadata.summary: The Los Angeles Rams bounced back from their dismal season opener in Australia to deliver a statement performance in their 28-6 victory against the New York Giants.
metadata.content: New York Giants 6-28 Los Angeles Rams: Matthew Stafford, Davante Adams star for Super Bowl favourites in statement win | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content New York Giants 6-28 Los Angeles Rams: Matthew Stafford, Davante Adams star for Super Bowl favourites in statement win Matthew Stafford threw four touchdown passes for the Los Angeles Rams, who welcomed Aaron Donald back to NFL for the first time since January 2024; New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart sustained a knee injury during their defeat Tuesday 22 September 2026 06:24, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Week 2 game between New York Giants and Los Angeles Rams The Los Angeles Rams bounced back from their dismal season opener in Australia to deliver a statement performance in their 28-6 victory against the New York Giants. Davante Adams made eight catches for 195 yards and hauled in two of Matthew Stafford's four touchdown passes on Monday night, while the Rams also welcomed Aaron Donald back to NFL for the first time in 32 months. Stafford passed for 327 yards for the Rams (1-1), who capitalised after the Giants (1-1) lost Jaxson Dart to a left knee injury on their first offensive series.
